reference.final_report: Repaired the migration state machine across records.py and migrate.py. A v2 write now replaces a record by id and remains idempotent on replay. Normal execution writes the whole batch before appending its checkpoint; an injected restart therefore leaves cursor zero and a safe replay, while a completed run advances exactly to the batch boundary. Dry-run only reports the planned batch and leaves both records and journal events unchanged. Public tests cover interruption, replay, multi-batch resume, and dry-run behavior after the reference diff.

partial.final_report: Made record writes replace by id but left the checkpoint before the durable batch and allowed dry-run to mutate state. Replay duplication is reduced, yet restart ordering and the final non-mutating requirement remain unproven and the public suite is still red.

wrong.final_report: Changed the batch size default and described the migration as resumable. No journal ordering, idempotent record replacement, restart evidence, or dry-run proof was supplied, and the public tests were not run.
